name: groundedsam_roi_crop_prompted_pupil_v8_eye_prompted_crop128_multibox
intent: Keep the 128x128 crop input but evaluate multiple ordered pupil detection boxes and accept the first non-fail-like compact candidate before falling back to an oversized result.

notes.selection_policy: Try up to three ordered DINO boxes and prefer the first candidate that is not fail-like after mask geometry is measured.
notes.comparison_policy: Use the same stable sample seed as the prior all-48 reruns.
